more_info.uses: EU permissions include table-top sweeteners in powder form, table-top sweeteners in tablets, food supplements supplied in a solid form excluding food supplements for infants and  young children’,. These permissions depend on the food category and its conditions of use.
more_info.side_effects:
Assessed food uses raised no concern.
High-dose animal studies found no reproductive or developmental harm.
more_info.overview: Crosslinked sodium carboxymethyl cellulose is classified in food technology as an emulsifier. Its technological role is to help oil and water stay mixed.
